bifrost: springboard/src/shell/settings.rs, springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (shell-owned Settings app; no third-party pane host)
summary: Apple's framework lets third-party bundles plug panes into System Settings, with a lifecycle (select, unselect veto) and Help menu keys. BifrOSt has a shell-owned Settings app with its own page model and a fixed shell Help menu, but no bundle or plugin host for external panes, no pane lifecycle notifications, and apps cannot add Help menu items.

features.note: No API lets an app or bundle supply a pane; Settings builds every page from its own PageId enum (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs).
Pages are built in code from specs; no nib or view load hook for external panes.

features.apple: willSelect, didSelect, willUnselect, didUnselect, shouldUnselect, reply(toShouldUnselect:)
features.note: Settings switches pages internally; no unselect veto is exposed to a pane.
Code search for a pane notification or event bus found no equivalent; the Settings app is the only consumer of its pages.

features.feature: Keyboard focus chain in a pane
features.note: Focus traversal exists as a pure model (next/nearest over Focusable items), but there is no per-pane initial or last key view and no autosave of text fields on pane change.

features.feature: Help menu entries from a pane
features.note: The shell Help menu has fixed rows (BifrOSt Information, Search, App Switcher, Back, Home); app menus cannot use the Help title (desktop_bar.rs:338 keeps Help shell-supplied), and there is no anchor or help-book lookup.

features.apple: System Settings panes as shipped by the OS (no app API)
features.note: The Settings app covers the OS preferences (network, display, notifications, focus, general) as its counterpart, but it is closed to third-party panes.

features.apple: Search across System Settings panes (not in the Preference Panes API)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/settings.rs (settings_search::filter on the root page), springboard/src/shell/quicksearch_math.rs
features.note: Root search filters the shell's own pages only; external panes cannot be indexed.

features.feature: Pane bundle format and Info.plist keys
features.apple: Preference pane bundle, NSPrefPaneHelpMenu* keys in the bundle property list
features.note: No pane bundle format or plist-based pane registration exists; apps are registered through the app bundle and manifest.toml instead.

gaps: No plugin host that loads a third-party pane into the Settings app (NSPreferencePane equivalent), so apps cannot add a settings pane.
No pane lifecycle (select, deselect with veto) or pane notifications for a Settings page.
Apps cannot add items to the shell Help menu or use a help anchor; the Help menu rows are fixed in desktop_bar.rs.
No per-pane initial and last key view, and no text field autosave on pane change.
No pane bundle format or plist-declared pane and help keys.
